record.body:
## Description

Many sessions report cost_usd null, so effort cost totals read low. Find out why with bounded reads of real transcripts: whether cost-state lines are absent, carry another field name, or are skipped by session_fields. Fix scripts/session_fields.py if the cause is in the code. If a transcript truly has no cost-state line, null stays correct and the report must say so.
